newsitem.title: JORDAN: Palestinian hijacker gives kidney to ill brother.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian hijacker gives kidney to ill brother.

text.p: Palestinian hijacker Leila Khaled has donated one of her kidneys to save her ill brother, her husband said on Saturday.

"The famous freedom fighter Leila Khaled has added to the great gifts to her cause and her people a new humanitarian gift," Fayez Rashid said. "She donated one of her kidneys to her brother Khaled, who suffered from kidney failure for years."

An official at the private hospital where the operation was carried out said the transplant took place on Wednesday. Rashid said in a statement it was a success and brother and sister were recuperating.

Leila Khaled, who is in her early 50s, commandeered an American TWA airliner in 1969. A member of the radical Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine, she was allowed by Israel to enter Palestinian-ruled areas in April for a meeting of the Palestine National Congress.
